positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
•Performed ASTM material and mechanical bench testing for nitinol implants  
•Managed validation processes (IQ/OQ/PQ) for manufacturing equipment and product labeling software
•Followed FDA Guidance on Design Controls while managing current and future product development projects
•Performed Risk Assessment Analysis for novel and current product lines of Nitinol Implants

positions.title: Biomedical Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Conducted research and development experiments for the Prevena Incision Management System   
• Followed laboratory SOPs to perform mechanical testing of biological tissue 
• Analysis of test results and preparation of a final report 
• Performed quality control/assurance documentation

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•Participated in multi-scale research projects involving the preclinical development of calcium phosphate scaffolds for military personnel with significant craniofacial or limb damage
•Processed bone scaffold specimens using tissue histology and histomorphometry techniques
•Prepared written articles and poster presentations for journal and conference publications
